before: Book a Perth plumber for a blocked drain, slow sink, backed-up shower or blocked toilet. Ellis Services Group investigates the affected drainage, explains the clearing or repair scope and provides a written quote. Our local team handles drainage requests for homes, rental properties and managed premises.
en: Book a plumber for blocked drains, slow-draining sinks, a backed-up shower or a blocked toilet. Ellis Services Group checks the affected drains, explains the clearing or repair work and provides a written quote. Our local team services homes, rental properties and managed premises.
zh: 预约水管工处理排水管堵塞、水槽排水缓慢、淋浴污水回流或马桶堵塞。Ellis Services Group 检查受影响的排水系统，说明疏通或维修范围，并提供书面报价。本地团队为住宅、出租物业和管理物业提供排水服务。

before: A slow sink, backed-up shower or rising toilet water needs a drainage assessment. Tell us which fixtures are affected and whether the problem returns after clearing. Avoid using affected fixtures when wastewater is returning, and keep people and pets clear of it. Our plumber explains the clearing scope and any separate investigation or drain repair before you approve the written quote. Photos are optional; do not approach wastewater to take them.
en:
Slow-draining sinks, water pooling in the shower or floor waste, rising toilet water and sewage backing up all need a drainage check. We inspect and clear kitchen, bathroom and toilet drains, checking whether the problem affects one drain or several.

Tell us what is happening, how long it has been happening and whether the drain has blocked again since it was last cleared. Before you accept the written quote, our plumber explains the proposed clearing work and any further inspection or drain repairs needed.

If sewage is backing up, stop using the affected sink, shower or toilet. Avoid contact with the sewage and keep people and pets away from the area.
zh:
水槽下水慢、淋浴间或地漏积水、马桶水位上涨或出现污水回流？我们提供厨房、浴室和马桶排水管的堵塞检查与疏通，区分单个排水点的问题与多个排水点同时受影响的情况。

请告诉我们具体症状、问题持续时间，以及之前疏通后是否再次堵塞。在您确认书面报价前，水管工会说明建议的疏通范围，以及是否需要额外检查或排水管维修。

污水回流提醒： 出现污水回流时，请停止使用受影响的水槽、淋浴或马桶，避免接触污水，并让人员和宠物远离受影响区域。

before: If a drain blocks again after being cleared, let us know what previous work was completed. Repeat symptoms can require further investigation rather than repeating the same treatment without checking the wider drainage. We discuss the access points and findings before recommending any separate repair work; the enquiry alone does not establish the cause.
en: If a drain blocks again after being cleared, let us know what work was done. Recurring blockages may need a wider inspection rather than the same treatment again.
zh: 如果排水在清除后再次堵塞，请告知已完成的工作。重复症状可能需要进一步调查，而不是在未检查更广泛排水的情况下重复相同处理。

before: We begin with the affected fixtures, the extent of the backup and the available drainage access. Our plumber assesses the appropriate treatment for the identified restriction and explains what the clearing visit covers. Any additional investigation, access work or pipe repair is identified separately so a simple clearing request does not become an undefined job.
en: We check the affected fixtures, how far the blockage is backing up and where we can access the drains. Our plumber explains the clearing work before carrying it out. Any further inspection, access work or pipe repairs are listed separately, so you know what the drain-clearing job covers.
zh: 我们从受影响的装置、回流程度和可用排水接入开始。我们的水管工评估后做对应的处理，并解释清楚涵盖的内容。任何额外调查、接入工作或管道修复工作都会单独标识，以免简单清除堵塞请求变成未定义工作。

before: cover related fixture and water-supply repairs alongside drainage.
en: also cover related fixture repairs, water supply and drainage.
zh: 涵盖相关配件和给排水维修。

before: Blocked toilet or shower drain: tell us which outlets are affected
zh: 堵塞的马桶或淋浴排水

before: For a price comparison, check whether the scope is initial clearing only or also includes further investigation or a defined repair. Confirm any additional access, inspection method or replacement work before approval. Do not assume that a camera survey or excavation is included in every clearing visit.
en: When comparing quotes, check whether they cover drain clearing only or include further inspection and repairs. Agree on any extra access, inspection or replacement work before it goes ahead.
zh: 在价格比较时，检查工作范围是仅初步清理还是还包括进一步调查或定义的修复。确认任何额外接入、检查方法或更换工作后再批准。
